compiled.q: Is the plaintext (non-TLS) port disabled, i.e. is the effective `port` 0?
compiled.code: (text) => { let effectivePort; const lines = text.split('\n'); for (const line of lines) { if (line.startsWith('#')) continue; const trimmed = line.trim(); if (!trimmed) continue; const parts = trimmed.split(/\s+/); if (parts[0] === 'port') { const val = parseInt(parts[1], 10); if (!isNaN(val)) effectivePort = val; } } return effectivePort === 0; }

Is AOF persistence enabled (appendonly yes in effect)?

compiled.code: (text) => text.split('\n').filter(line => !/^\s*#/.test(line.trim())).some(line => { const parts = line.trim().split(/\s+/); return parts[0].toLowerCase() === 'maxmemory' && parts.length > 1; })

compiled.q: Is the memory limit at least 1 GB?
compiled.code: (text) => { const lines = text.split(/\r?\n/); let maxBytes; const gb = 1024**3; const unitFactors = {'':1,'b':1,'kb':1024,'mb':1024**2,'gb':1024**3,'tb':1024**4}; const re = /^\s*maxmemory\s+(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*([a-zA-Z]*)\s*$/i; for (const line of lines) { const trimmed = line.trim(); if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith('#')) continue; const m = trimmed.match(re); if (m) { const [, val, unit] = m; const factor = unitFactors[unit.toLowerCase()] ?? 1; maxBytes = parseFloat(val) * factor; } } return maxBytes != null && maxBytes >= gb; }

compiled.q: Does the eviction policy evict keys when memory is full (anything but noeviction)?

compiled.code: (text) => { let last = null; const re = /^\s*requirepass\s*(.*)$/i; for (const line of text.split('\n')) { const trimmed = line.trim(); if (trimmed.startsWith('#')) continue; const m = re.exec(trimmed); if (m) { last = m[1]; } } return last !== null && last.length > 0; }

compiled.q: Is Redis bound only to the loopback interface?
compiled.code: (text) => { const lines = text.split(/\r?\n/); let binds = null; const bindRe = /^bind\s+(.+)$/i; for (const line of lines) { const l = line.trim(); if (l.charAt(0) === '#') continue; const m = l.match(bindRe); if (m) { const addrs = m[1].split(/\s+/).map(s => s.trim()).filter(s => s); binds = addrs; } } if (!binds) return false; return binds.every(a => /^(127\.\d{1,3}\.\d{1,3}\.\d{1,3}|::1|localhost)$/i.test(a)); }

compiled.q: Is Redis listening on all interfaces (bind 0.0.0.0)?
compiled.code: (text) => { const lines = text.split(/\r?\n/); let bind = null; for (const l of lines) { const t = l.trim(); if (t.startsWith('#')) continue; const m = t.match(/^bind\s+(.*)$/i); if (m) bind = m[1].trim(); } return bind ? bind.split(/\s+/).some(a => a === '0.0.0.0') : false; }

(text) => { let port; text.split('\n').forEach(line => { const trimmed = line.trim(); if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith('#')) return; const match = trimmed.match(/^(\S+)\s+(.*)/); if (match && match[1] === 'port') port = match[2].replace(/\s+#.*/, '').trim(); }); return !port || port === '6379'; }
